description:

Chief of Staff-level role | Walnut Insurance | Remote, Canada | Partner to the COO and CPO
The role
You'll be the operating and strategy partner to our COO and CPO. Half the job is the work a top strategy consultant does for a client: help decision, size the opportunity, build the case, pressure-test the plan, write the recommendation. The other half is what a good chief of staff does: turn that decision into execution, so momentum never depends on two people's calendars. You'll work across sales, product and partnerships as we grow in Canada and the US, in a regulated industry where banks, telcos, lenders and insurers are the buyers. And you'll do it with an AI-native toolkit that lets one person deliver what used to take a team.
About Walnut
Walnut is Canada's leading embedded insurance platform. Partners like Wealthsimple, BMO, KOHO and TELUS use us to launch insurance inside their products in 90 days, compared with nine months or more going direct to a carrier. We hold the carrier relationships, the licences and the compliance; our partners keep the customer.
Non-negotiable: you build with AI every day
You've done strategy work to a top-tier standard, in financial services. Maybe that was at a leading consultancy, in a bank or insurer's strategy or corporate development group, at a fintech or insurtech, or in a founder's office doing the same job without the title. You know how a bank, a carrier and an enterprise buyer make decisions, and how long they take. You can read a partner's P&L, a loss ratio and a take rate and tell us whether a program will make money. And you can write a board-grade recommendation on one page.
AI is how you already work, not a tool you'll pick up here. You build agents, Claude Skills and automated workflows as a daily habit, connect them to live systems like HubSpot, Slack and email through APIs and MCP, and can show us what you've built and the impact it had. If you use AI only for drafting and summarizing, this isn't the role.
What you'll do

• Run strategy the way a consultant would. Own the thinking behind our biggest calls: which markets and channels come first, how we price a program, which partners we chase and which we pass on, what a carrier deal is worth. Size markets from the bottom up, model partner economics, map the competition, and bring the COO and CPO options with a recommendation, the trade-offs and the point at which you'd change your mind. You'll run the weekly strategic review that keeps every initiative red, yellow or green.

• Make the call, or frame it. Decide what's yours to decide inside agreed guardrails, and bring the rest to the COO and CPO framed so the decision takes ten minutes. Brief them before key meetings, send recaps with decisions, owners and dates, and hand work off to named owners with clear scope.

• Own follow-through. Keep one current view of what's owed to and by the COO and CPO across partners, carriers and the team. Raise risks before they slip and push deals and projects forward between meetings.

• Shape the deals that matter. Work alongside our Sales Team on pipeline, HubSpot reporting and sales infrastructure. Build the business cases, solution outlines and proposals for enterprise deals with banks, telcos and lenders, and help us build the go-to-market in both markets.

• Build the materials. Turn notes, data and rough direction into executive, investor, partner and board decks, briefs and models, with accurate numbers and a clear point of view. You'll prepare board materials but won't attend board meetings.

• Keep one version of the facts. Maintain the roadmap, requirements and partner records, and make sure material decisions are captured in writing.

title: Thermal Engineer
description:
COMPANY

NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there.

Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris.

Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators.

Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it.

Role

We are looking for a skilled Thermal Engineer with experience in spacecraft thermal management at both the subsystem and spacecraft level.

You’ll work closely with a cross-functional team - including mechanical, propulsion, electronics, and mission planning - to ensure reliable thermal performance of our satellite throughout all mission phases: from launch to operation in orbit and end-of-life.

You should be capable of delivering a thermal control system from scratch and taking full ownership of it, ensuring the success of our mission.

Key Responsibilities

- Perform steady-state and transient thermal analysis of the spacecraft across all mission phases (TVAC testing, launch, orbit).

- Model and validate heat management strategies in the harsh environment of vacuum, where conduction and radiation are dominant

- Identify and manage worst-case scenarios in extreme thermal conditions (both hot and cold), accounting for on-orbit environmental factors and internal power dissipation

- Design and implement thermal control solutions such as multilayer insulation (MLI), radiators, heaters, thermo-optical coatings, thermistors, and thermal straps

- Develop and support thermal vacuum (TVAC) test procedures, instrumentation setup, and post-test data analysis.

- Be hands on in hardware testing for validation of processes, instrumentation, and materials and components chosen for in house developments

Fundamental Requirements

- Solid understanding of thermal engineering principles in the context of spacecraft systems.

- Hands-on experience with thermal simulation tools such as Systema, Thermal Desktop, ESATAN, or equivalent.

- Experience with environmental and lab testing (TVAC, thermal cycling, AIT process
validation).

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, iterative development environment.

Nice-to-Haves

- Experience designing or testing spacecraft thermal systems.

- Exposure to multidisciplinary space system development or mission analysis.

WHY NEWORBIT SPACE?

- Pioneering space technology - Your work on our RF gridded ion thrusters and VLEO satellite platform will redefine satellite operations and challenge traditional LEO.

- Ownership and impact - You'll have a level of ownership that's rare in the space industry, and you'll take part in the full lifecycle of satellite technology.

- Equity and competitive salary - Alongside a competitive salary you receive a company ownership stake, so you share in the technology you help build and in our collective success.

- Comprehensive benefits - Private health insurance with dental and optical cover, and annual health check-ups.

By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Business Development Recruiting team is responsible for attracting and hiring the talent that builds Anduril's growth engine. We recruit across the full spectrum of Business Development, including Capture, Strategy & Proposals, Business Development Representatives, Government Relations, and Program Management. As Anduril scales into new markets, new programs of record, and new customer sets, these functions grow in complexity and criticality - and the quality of the people we bring in directly shapes how the company identifies, wins, and expands its most consequential opportunities.

ABOUT THE JOB

In this role, you will own full-cycle recruiting across Business Development, Government Relations, and Program Management, while providing flex support to adjacent Growth searches as needed. You will build deep partnerships with your hiring managers, becoming a trusted extension of their teams, while developing real relationships with candidates throughout the process. This will require the versatility to context-switch across searches that demand very different domain fluency, candidate pools, and assessment approaches. In a given week you might be sourcing a Capture Manager with PEO experience, screening a Director of Business Development - Air Force for our Air Dominance & Strike Division and closing a Senior Proposal Manager who has run $500M+ competitive bids. You will need to learn each sub-function well enough to credibly evaluate candidates and advise hiring managers on talent strategy, market dynamics, and role design. If you are someone who thrives on variety, closes with precision, and earns trust from both hiring managers and candidates through the quality of your work, this role is for you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Full-Cycle Recruiting Execution

• Own end-to-end recruiting across Business Development, Government Relations, and Program Management, with flex capacity into adjacent Growth hiring during peak periods

• Develop and execute sourcing strategies tailored to each sub-function, recognizing that a capture manager pipeline rooted in the DoD acquisition community looks very different from a government relations pipeline built around former Hill staff and agency liaisons

• Conduct screens that assess functional depth, customer knowledge, and organizational fit, with an evaluation approach calibrated to each search - a capture lead requires different proof points than a proposal manager or a BD representative

• Manage the interview process from intake through close: calibrate with hiring managers, prepare interview panels, facilitate debriefs, and drive offers to signature

Strategic Partnership

• Partner with BD and Growth leaders to understand current and upcoming hiring needs, team composition, and the specific profiles that will succeed in each sub-function and division

• Advise hiring managers on market conditions, compensation benchmarks, and candidate availability across BD disciplines - including where cleared talent is concentrated and what it takes to move senior candidates out of primes or government service

• Provide transparent pipeline updates and market intelligence, especially when conditions require recalibrating timelines, expectations, or clearance assumptions

title: Engineering Manager, Mobile Platform
description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. 

About the Team

Verkada is building the operating system for the physical world. The Mobile Platform team, part of Verkada Core, owns the Verkada Command apps for iOS and Android: the apps customers use to manage cameras, access control, alarms, sensors, and more, wherever they are.

Our apps combine native Swift and Kotlin with web views connected through a JS bridge. Your mandate is to make them fast, stable, and consistent, and to decide where native wins and where web views make sense.

What You'll Do

• Lead & Grow the Team: Manage ~8-10 iOS and Android engineers and hire 1-2 more. Coach, give regular feedback, manage performance, and grow careers.

• Own the Native vs Web View Strategy: Define the criteria for which app surfaces stay native and which run as web views. Drive migrations where native is the right call.

• Make Hybrid Excellent: Improve JS bridge performance, shared components, and feature parity with web, so customers get one consistent experience.

• Performance & Stability: Own app launch and screen load time, UI responsiveness, bridge and network latency, and crash/ANR rates. Set metrics and budgets, and stop regressions before they ship.

• Player-Coach: Stay hands-on (~20-30%): prototype, review critical code, and dig into performance issues with the team.

• One Roadmap, Two Platforms: Run iOS and Android as one team with shared standards, architecture, and delivery.

• Partner Across Verkada: Work with Product, Design, Web, and product teams (Cameras, Access Control, Alarms, and more) to plan and ship.

• Raise the Bar: Drive strong code review, testing, and release quality.

What You Bring

• BS or MS in Computer Science or a related engineering field.

• 7+ years of software engineering experience, with significant time in mobile.

• 3+ years managing engineers, including hiring, performance management, and career growth.

• Production depth in either pr both iOS (Swift, SwiftUI/UIKit) and Android (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose).

• Shipped hybrid apps that combine native code with web views and a JS bridge.

• A track record of measurably improving mobile performance and stability (load time, responsiveness, crash rate).

• Strong architecture judgment and clear written communication.

Nice to have

• Web frontend experience (React, TypeScript).

• Mobile platform work: modularization, CI/CD, release engineering.

• B2B or enterprise mobile apps at scale.

title: Mechanical Engineer III
description:
DLB Associates is a premier engineering and consulting firm specializing in innovative, mission-critical solutions across hyperscale data centers, advanced infrastructure, and high-performance building systems. With over four decades of expertise, we partner with some of the world’s most influential companies to design and optimize environments that demand precision, scalability, and resilience.

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Position Title: Mechanical Engineer III

Position Location: Remote - work virtually from anywhere in the United States

Job Summary

Positions are available in our Mission Critical Department which focus primarily on hyperscale data centers and related mission critical facilities.

The Mechanical Engineer III will have the opportunity to work with and collaborate with senior design staff and further develop their mechanical design expertise. This person will work as part of the Engineering Team and interact closely with the Project Management Team to produce construction documents, develop and edit project specifications and lead the construction administration process.

The Mechanical Engineer III will receive limited direction on day-to-day work and general instruction on new projects or assignments.  Will execute and assist project leadership on projects of complex scope.  Will work independently or under limited supervision.

The Mechanical Engineer III will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals and values, as well as departmental objectives.

Essential Functions

Guide and Direct Production of Mechanical Engineering Documents (50%)

• Independently perform intermediate to advanced engineering work

• Perform intermediate to advanced mechanical design tasks under a senior engineer’s supervision

• Perform intermediate to advanced computations and analysis for mechanical systems

• Utilize Revit software to prepare drawings and visual aids

• Review and write HVAC controls sequence of operations

Guide and Direct Pre-Construction Activities (15%)

• Survey existing building conditions and prepare technical reports of findings

• Collect data and other information for construction documents

• Prepare project design and construction documents

Guide and Direct Construction Activities (25%)

• Work as part of the engineering team and interact closely with the project management team

• Interact directly with client on technical issues

• Review shop drawings and submittals

• Review and respond to RFIs

• Review and complete punch lists and project close out documents 

Reporting (10%)

• Prepare project progress reports for internal and external stakeholders

• Update and maintain shop drawing and RFI log

• Manage personal hours using company tools

Technology, Digital Tools & AI-Enabled Efficiency

• Leverage AI-enabled and digital tools to enhance efficiency, reduce manual effort, and support consistent, high-quality work output.

• Identify opportunities to improve processes and demonstrate a continuous learning mindset, seeking out new technologies, skills, and methods that elevate individual and team performance.

• Adapt to emerging technologies and evolving digital workflows, actively supporting the integration and adoption of innovative tools across the organization.

Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

Position Requirements (Intermediate level for all the following except as noted)

• Knowledge of designing mechanical systems

• Knowledge of codes, code analysis and specifications for mechanical systems

• Knowledge of DDC controls and monitoring for HVAC systems

• Knowledge of electrical systems related to HVAC systems

• Knowledge of fire alarm / protection system devices

• Skilled at producing drawings and visual aids using Revit

• Skilled in performing and analyzing load calculations
